name: mythfall-portrait-mara_vell
instruction: A polished hand-painted portrait for a grounded medieval fantasy roleplaying game, bust portrait with face clearly readable at small sizes, softly textured gouache and oil paint, subtle expressive eyes, warm candlelight and cool misty shadows, muted moss green, brown and aged gold. Square composition, centered head and shoulders, plain dark desaturated green backdrop, no frame, no writing, no UI, no extra people. Mara Vell, a practical middle-aged female village reeve with dark tied-back hair, visibly underslept but determined, a plain blue wool coat and a small brass seal brooch.
